texts.label: text
texts.orig: Our aim in this section is to prove the existence and uniqueness of solutions for the system outlined in equation (9). We begin by examining the local dynamics through the isolation of the convolution term and leveraging established principles from the theory of semilinear evolution equations. Following this, we integrate insights from the theory of nonlocal balance equations, as elaborated in [21] and [22], to affirm the existence and uniqueness of the solutions for the system mentioned in equation (2).
